DesignMD — Generate DESIGN.md Files with AI

name: Generate
summary: DesignMD's generate flow: paste a website URL and get a structured DESIGN.md, an HTML preview and a one-click Figma import.
description: The generator page of DesignMD: it crawls a site's key pages and reads the computed styles, then returns a structured DESIGN.md covering colour roles, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, components and breakpoints, plus a live HTML preview and a one-click Figma import. Aimed at handing AI coding agents the design system of a reference site; 4 credits per spec, no card to start.
contains: paste a URL; the site's key pages and computed styles are read
structured DESIGN.md covering colours, typography, spacing, radius, elevation, components and breakpoints
live HTML preview and one-click Figma import
4 credits per spec; no card to start
